2026-08-06.title: **GOBARdhan Scheme: ₹23,731 Crore Outlay for Compressed Biogas**
bullets: **GOBARdhan Scheme Launched**: The Union Cabinet has approved the GOBARdhan scheme for compressed biogas with a budget outlay of ₹23,731 crore.
**Key Features**: The scheme aims to promote the use of compressed biogas as a clean fuel, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and create employment opportunities in rural areas.
**Implementation**: The scheme will be implemented by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, in collaboration with state governments and other stakeholders.

2026-08-06.title: **UDAN Scheme: Helicopter Services to be Launched on Shimla-Chandigarh Route**
bullets: **UDAN Scheme Expansion**: The Union Cabinet has approved the expansion of the UDAN scheme to include helicopter services on the Shimla-Chandigarh route.
**Key Features**: The scheme aims to promote regional air connectivity, reduce travel time, and increase economic opportunities in rural areas.
**Implementation**: The scheme will be implemented by the Ministry of Civil Aviation, in collaboration with state governments and other stakeholders.

2026-08-06.title: **Agni-4 Missile Test: DRDO Conducts Successful Trial**
bullets: **Agni-4 Missile Test**: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has successfully tested the Agni-4 missile, which has a range of over 4,000 km.
**Key Features**: The missile is a surface-to-surface ballistic missile, designed to carry nuclear warheads, and is a key component of India's nuclear deterrence strategy.
**Implementation**: The missile is being developed by the DRDO, in collaboration with the Indian Army and other stakeholders.

2026-08-06.title: **RBI's New Norms for Loan Recovery: No Phone Locking**
bullets: **RBI's New Norms**: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new norms for loan recovery, which prohibit the locking of phones and other devices.
**Key Features**: The new norms aim to protect consumers from harassment by loan recovery agents, and ensure that they are treated fairly and transparently.
**Implementation**: The new norms will be implemented by all banks and financial institutions, in accordance with RBI guidelines.

2026-08-06.title: **Andhra Pradesh Cabinet Approves PPP Policy and Ease of Doing Business Act**
bullets: **Andhra Pradesh Cabinet Decision**: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet has approved the PPP Policy and Ease of Doing Business Act, aimed at promoting business growth and investment in the state.
**Key Features**: The policy aims to simplify business procedures, reduce regulatory hurdles, and increase transparency in government dealings.
**Implementation**: The policy will be implemented by the Andhra Pradesh government, in collaboration with industry stakeholders and other partners.

2026-08-06.title: **Cabinet Approves ₹8,970 Crore Access-Controlled Highway from Guwahati to Tezpur**
bullets: **Highway Project Approval**: The Union Cabinet has approved the ₹8,970 crore access-controlled highway project from Guwahati to Tezpur in Assam.
**Key Features**: The project aims to improve road connectivity, reduce travel time, and increase economic opportunities in the region.
**Implementation**: The project will be implemented by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, in collaboration with the Assam government and other stakeholders.

2026-08-06.title: **RBI to Introduce Plastic Notes by April-May 2027**
bullets: **Plastic Notes Introduction**: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) plans to introduce plastic notes by April-May 2027, as part of its efforts to reduce paper usage and increase security features.
**Key Features**: The new plastic notes will have enhanced security features, including a unique number and a hologram, to prevent counterfeiting.
**Implementation**: The introduction of plastic notes will be a phased process, with the RBI working closely with banks and other stakeholders to ensure a smooth transition.

2026-08-06.title: **Bihar Government to Re-employ 22,000 Anganwadi Workers**
bullets: **Anganwadi Workers Re-employment**: The Bihar government has decided to re-employ 22,000 Anganwadi workers, who were earlier terminated due to a Supreme Court order.
**Key Features**: The decision aims to provide employment opportunities to women in rural areas, and ensure the continuation of Anganwadi services.
**Implementation**: The re-employment of Anganwadi workers will be implemented by the Bihar government, in collaboration with the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

2026-08-06.title: **RBI Introduces New Norms for NBFCs**
bullets: **NBFC Norms Introduction**: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new norms for Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), aimed at improving their governance and risk management practices.
**Key Features**: The new norms require NBFCs to maintain higher capital adequacy ratios, improve their risk management systems, and enhance their governance structures.
**Implementation**: The new norms will be implemented by all NBFCs, in accordance with RBI guidelines.

2026-08-06.title: **ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026: Various Posts Available**
bullets: **ISRO Recruitment**: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has announced recruitment for various posts, including Assistant-Stenographer and Clerk.
**Key Features**: The recruitment aims to fill vacant positions in ISRO, and provide opportunities for young and talented individuals to join the organisation.
**Implementation**: The recruitment process will be conducted by ISRO, in collaboration with the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).
